# Thunderbird Mail GUI Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System Status Bar**: Located at the top of the screen, displaying system information.
  - Left: "Activities" button.
  - Center: Date and time "Oct 23 17:43".
  - Right: System icons including network, sound, and power.

- **Application Title Bar**: "Address Book - Mozilla Thunderbird".
  - Left: Thunderbird logo.
  - Center: Application title.
  - Right: Standard window controls (minimize, maximize, close).

## Main Application Window

- **Search Bar**: Positioned at the top of the main window.
  - Placeholder text: "Search...".
  - Shortcut: "CTRL + K".
  - Right side: Search icon (magnifying glass).

- **Navigation Menu Bar**: Horizontal menu bar with standard application menu items.
  - Items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help.

- **Toolbar**: Located below the menu bar.
  - Left: Action buttons: "Send", "Encrypt", "Spelling" (with dropdown), "Save" (with dropdown), "Contacts".
  - Right: "Attach" button (with dropdown).

## Email Composition Window

- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird".

- **Window Controls**: Top-right corner.
  - Minimize, maximize, close buttons.

- **Email Header Fields**:
  - **From**: 
    - Currently selected: "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>".
    - Dropdown arrow next to the email address.
    - Dropdown menu is open, showing:
      - "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>" (highlighted in blue).
      - "Customize From Address...".
  - **To**: Empty field.
  - **Cc**: Empty field.
  - **Bcc**: Empty field.

- **Subject Field**: Empty.

- **Formatting Toolbar**: Below the header fields.
  - Left: "Paragraph" dropdown.
  - Next: "Variable Width" dropdown.
  - Formatting buttons: Align left, center, right, justify, bold (B), italic (I), underline (U), strikethrough (S), font color, text color, list options, indent, outdent, smiley face (emoji) button.

- **Email Body**: Large white area for composing the email content. Currently empty.

- **Edit Button**: Located to the right of the subject field. Gray button labeled "Edit".

## Address Book Panel

- **Panel Title**: "Contacts".

- **Address Book Selection**:
  - "Address Book:" dropdown.
  - Currently selected: "All Address Books".

- **Search Contacts**:
  - Search bar with placeholder: "Name or Email".
  - Search icon (magnifying glass) to the left of the search bar.
  - Dropdown arrow next to the search bar.

- **Contact List**:
  - Single contact displayed: "anonym-x20..."

- **Action Buttons**:
  - "Add to To:" button.
  - "Add to Cc:" button.
  - "Add to Bcc:" button.

- **Footer Information**:
  - "Total contacts in all address books: 1".
  - Status indicator: "( ) Done".

## Left Sidebar (Application Dock)

- **Application Icons**:
  - Chrome browser.
  - Firefox browser.
  - Thunderbird Mail.
  - Calendar.
  - Task Manager.
  - VLC Media Player.
  - LibreOffice Writer.
  - LibreOffice Calc.
  - LibreOffice Impress.
  - GIMP.
  - File Manager.
  - Software Center.
  - Help icon.
  - Trash icon.

- **Application Launcher Grid**: Bottom of the sidebar.
  - 3x3 grid of dots for launching applications.

## System Tray

- Located at the top-right corner of the screen.
- Icons for system functions: network, sound, power.
